divisor-7.what: the last level divides by 7 for 6 (the x^3 coefficient is 1/7). KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 1 (3F800000) the planted graph gives 3F5D36D6 and sin 1 lies between 3F576AA4 and 3F576AA5. Refused where the graph no longer folds into the levels the proof walks

first-divisor-211.what: the first level divides by 211 for 210 (the x^15 coefficient a little off). NOT known false: MEASURED on 60,000 inputs, 0 not faithful (the graph has more accuracy than the statement asks). Refused only by the route of the proof: the graph no longer folds into the levels the proof walks

add-for-mul.what: the last operation is x + t for x * t. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 0 the planted graph gives 1 (3F800000) and sin 0 = 0. Refused where the proof meets the last operation

hand-edited-graph.what: Graph.v with one blank added at the end of a line: the same graph for Coq, and not what emit_sin32.py prints

prem-no-smax.what: SIN32 without |x| <= SMAX. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 8 (41000000) the graph gives C08A224D and sin 8 lies between 3F7D4695 and 3F7D4696. Refused where the proof takes the premise

prem-smax-pi.what: SMAX doubled (the binary32 number nearest pi). KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 40490FDB the graph gives B566E91D and sin x lies between B3BBBD2F and B3BBBD2E. Refused where the proof needs SMAX^2 <= 5/2

prem-finite-no-smax.what: SIN32_FINITE without |x| <= SMAX. False, ARGUED and not evaluated: the model has no overflow, and at x = 2^127 the polynomial is of the order of x^14, far above FMAX32. Refused where the proof takes the premise

concl-round-down.what: SIN32 says the result is sin x rounded DOWN. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 2^-100 (0D800000) the graph gives x itself, 0D800000, and sin x rounded down is 0D7FFFFF. Refused where lemma F32 no longer fits

concl-correct.what: SIN32 claims the correctly rounded result. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 3FC8DB65 the graph gives 3F7FFFEA and the correctly rounded sin x is 3F7FFFEB (the first such input found going down from SMAX, after 13,431). Refused where lemma F32 no longer fits

concl-finite-half.what: SIN32_FINITE says the result is at most 1/2 in magnitude. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = SMAX (3FC90FDB) the graph gives 1 (3F800000). Refused where faithful_finite no longer fits

admitted.what: Sin32.lv_first (the first level of the polynomial) ends with Admitted for its last step

trunc-axiom.what: the truncation bound sin_trunc_pos is an Axiom of Trunc.v (the same text, its proof removed), used by the top theorem through sin_trunc

other-statement.what: Sin32.v states, under the name SIN32_ALL, the proposition True and proves that

guard.what: sin32_all from False, by a recursion whose termination check is switched off
